summary: Frontend-only re-test of iteration 3. CRITICAL LineReveal fix VERIFIED: all 7 section H2 headings (#overview, #manifesto, #residences, #gallery, #amenities, #location, #enquiry) now animate to y=0 — every word span computes to matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0) (or none) after instant scroll + 1800ms wait, and each heading is clearly visible in the 1920x900 screenshots. All iteration-2 regressions hold: no 'floor plan' text or floor-plans-section in DOM; manifesto stacks without overlap at 768px (01: 577-623, title: 639-675, body: 691-743); marquee band height = 36px (<=100px). Testids verified: header-enquire-btn, hero-cta-enquire, hero-cta-residences all present; old hero-cta-floorplans count = 0. Footer legal tabs open/close correctly with only one expanded at a time (aria-expanded verified across 3 interactions). Lead form submitted successfully with enquiry-success 'Thank you.' card. One NEW design/CSS defect found in Header (scrolled state has no background color).

ui_bugs.issue: Scrolled header has NO background: class `bg-[#24160F]/92` is never generated by Tailwind because 92 is not in the default opacity scale (only 0,5,10..95 exist). Verified via stylesheet scan — only .bg-[#24160F]/40 exists; computed backgroundColor of the scrolled header is rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) while class list contains bg-[#24160F]/92. Result: header relies solely on backdrop-blur, and over dark sections (manifesto, gallery, amenities, enquiry) the bar renders washed-out light cream, making the cream nav links (rgba(233,214,199,0.85)) and 'REGISTER INTEREST' CTA text nearly unreadable (see screenshots of #manifesto/#amenities/#enquiry). Fix: use `bg-[#24160F]/[0.92]` or `bg-[#24160F]/90`.

issues: Nav links and CTA label lose contrast because scrolled header background class does not compile (see ui_bugs)

action_items: Header.jsx line 40: replace bg-[#24160F]/92 with bg-[#24160F]/[0.92] (or /90) so the scrolled header actually gets an opaque dark background and nav/CTA text stays readable over dark sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind slash-opacity modifiers must use values from the opacity scale (or bracket syntax) — bg-[#24160F]/92 silently produced no CSS; grep confirmed this is the only such occurrence in src/.

Reveal.jsx LineReveal now correctly observes the outer (non-clipped) wrapper with useInView(amount: 0.15, margin '0px 0px -10% 0px') and drives the inner span via animate — behaviour is deterministic and verified.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 requested checks passed; 1 new unrelated header contrast/CSS bug found

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-2 LineReveal bug root cause (now fixed): whileInView was attached to the inner clipped span with viewport.amount 0.5, which could never be satisfied inside overflow:hidden. New code observes the outer wrapper. New header bug root cause: Tailwind JIT does not emit a class for an opacity modifier outside the theme opacity scale, so /92 yields no background-color declaration.
